types.title: Grids Document
types.description: One stored immutable document and its artifact metadata.

types.title: Grids Record
types.description: One stable record in a Grids Table.

types.title: Grids Table
types.description: A readable stored or Combined table in a base.

types.title: Grids View
types.description: A permission-scoped saved GQL data view.

types.title: Grids Workflow Run
types.description: Status of one accepted workflow operation.

queries.title: List Grids bases
queries.description: Normal entry for base-scoped Grids work. List accessible bases and use returned grids.base refs or IDs with base.read, gql.context, gql.preview, gql.execute, or gql.view.execute.

query.description: Optional base name, description, or short-ID search.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Read Grids base
queries.description: Read one grids.base ref returned by base.list or base.search.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Search Grids bases
queries.description: Find an accessible Grids base by name, description, or short ID when its ID is unknown. Use returned grids.base refs with base.read or their IDs with gql.context and GQL queries.

query.description: User-entered search text. Empty text is allowed when a facet narrows the query.

tags.description: Canonical search facets supported by this query.

scope.description: Optional resource containing the search results; must be an explicitly supported scope type.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

context.description: One line in the caller's locale that says what and where the resource is and its most useful fact, for example 'Task in IT planning · due 30 Oct'.

status.description: The resource's current state as a short label in the caller's locale, for example 'Open' or 'Done'.

priority.description: App-local relevance hint from zero to nine.

metadata.description: Small structured metadata shown with the result.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Read document content
queries.description: Read one stored immutable artifact as an authenticated binary stream. Use a document ID from document.list/read/create and optionally an artifact key from document.read. Does not render, issue, extract text or send a document.

id.description: Public ID from the corresponding discovery result or resource reference.

artifactKey.description: Artifact key from document.read; defaults to the primary artifact.

downloadUrl.description: Authenticated same-origin download path. Not a public share; access is checked on every download.

queries.title: Find stored documents
queries.description: Read a bounded page of immutable documents for a template from document.templates. Follow document refs with document.read. Does not render or issue documents.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum candidates inspected on this page.

downloadUrl.description: Authenticated same-origin download path. Not a public share; access is checked on every download.
Authenticated same-origin download path. Not a public share; access is checked on every download. Returns the stored primary artifact.

queries.title: Read stored document
queries.description: Read metadata and artifact hashes for a grids.document ref from document.list or document.create. Every document and artifact carries an authenticated downloadUrl that returns stored bytes, not a new rendering.

id.description: Public ID from the corresponding discovery result or resource reference.

downloadUrl.description: Authenticated same-origin download path. Not a public share; access is checked on every download.
Authenticated same-origin download path. Not a public share; access is checked on every download. Returns the stored primary artifact.

queries.title: Find document templates
queries.description: Discover templates for a table from gql.context. Use an enabled template ID and a record from that table with document.create or document.list.

offset.description: Next offset from discovery; zero for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum candidates inspected on this page.

queries.title: Load Grids GQL context
queries.description: Load compact schema for a known task. If the source is unknown, request tables first; otherwise request fields with tableId. Options and list-columns need tableId and fieldId. List columns include typed constraints and calculations; follow pagination. Omit unused IDs, never send empty strings. Use includeWriteContext only before record writes. Views can feed gql.view.execute.

kind.description: Catalog section: tables, views, fields, select options, or typed object-list columns.

tableId.description: Public Table ID; required for fields, options and list-columns, optional for views.

fieldId.description: Public Field ID; required for options or list-columns. Optional filter for fields.

includeWriteContext.description: For kind fields only: include writable/required flags and record audit requirements before a record write. Omit for queries.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

queries.title: Execute Grids GQL
queries.description: Execute permission-safe GQL after gql.context and normally gql.preview. Select only needed fields; returned grids.record refs can be opened with record.read, and nextCursor continues byte-bounded pages.

query.description: Grids Query Language source to execute.

currentTableId.description: Optional public Table ID used when the source omits an explicit from clause.

currentSource.description: Optional current Table or View source used when GQL omits from.

kind.description: Select a Table as the current source.
Select a View as the current source.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.description: Values for @params.name only; scalars, exact {decimal: string} values or flat lists. No auth/page context. Parameterized results omit the editor link.

showTableToUser.description: Show this result as a table to the user. Use true for requested results, false for research or intermediate queries. When true, do not repeat the table in Markdown.

pageSize.description: Maximum rows to return on this cursor page.

limit.description: Optional logical result cap across cursor pages.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Preview Grids GQL
queries.description: Validate permission-safe GQL after loading IDs with gql.context. Returns a small sample or actionable diagnostics without mutation; pass valid GQL unchanged to gql.execute.

query.description: Grids Query Language source to execute.

currentTableId.description: Optional public Table ID used when the source omits an explicit from clause.

currentSource.description: Optional current Table or View source used when GQL omits from.

kind.description: Select a Table as the current source.
Select a View as the current source.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.description: Values for @params.name only; scalars, exact {decimal: string} values or flat lists. No auth/page context. Parameterized results omit the editor link.

showTableToUser.description: Show this result as a table to the user. Use true for requested results, false for research or intermediate queries. When true, do not repeat the table in Markdown.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Execute saved Grids View
queries.description: Execute the exact saved query in the target base for a viewId returned by gql.context kind views. This is the direct saved-view path; use gql.execute for ad-hoc GQL and nextCursor for further pages.

viewId.description: Public saved View ID whose exact stored GQL should execute.

showTableToUser.description: Show this result as a table to the user. Use true for requested results, false for research or intermediate queries. When true, do not repeat the table in Markdown.

pageSize.description: Maximum rows to return on this cursor page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Read Grids Record
queries.description: Read one grids.record ref returned by gql.execute, gql.preview, or a record Action. Returns metadata, finalization state, and the current version for record.update; use targeted gql.execute to read field values.

queries.title: Read Grids Table
queries.description: Read one grids.table ref returned by gql.context kind tables, including its base context and effective permission.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Read Grids View
queries.description: Read one grids.view ref returned by gql.context kind views; execute it with gql.view.execute using the same base target.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Find record workflow actions
queries.description: Discover configured correction/cancellation Draft actions in a base from base.list. Pages may be empty after permission/revision filtering; follow nextOffset. Use the returned table with GQL to find a finalized original, then workflow.record-action.

offset.description: Next offset from discovery; zero for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum candidates inspected on this page.

queries.title: Read workflow run status
queries.description: Read the current status of a grids.workflow-run ref returned by workflow.record-action. Requires base read access; no raw inputs, results or internal event payloads are returned.

id.description: Public ID from the corresponding discovery result or resource reference.

actions.title: Issue an immutable document
actions.description: Issue one document from document.templates and a Record. This may assign an irreversible invoice/document number. Review every issuance; reuse the capability idempotency key only for retries of the same request. No compliance guarantee or external delivery.

templateId.description: Enabled template public ID from document.templates.

recordId.description: Record public ID from the template table, obtained with GQL.

downloadUrl.description: Authenticated same-origin download path. Not a public share; access is checked on every download.
Authenticated same-origin download path. Not a public share; access is checked on every download. Returns the stored primary artifact.

actions.title: Create Grids Record
actions.description: Call gql.context kind fields with includeWriteContext true first, then create once with values keyed by writable Field public ID. Select values use option IDs. Returns bounded metadata; read values with targeted GQL. Reuse the idempotency key only to retry the same create.

values.description: Public Field IDs mapped to explicitly supplied values.

actions.title: Update Grids Record
actions.description: Load gql.context kind fields with includeWriteContext true for value and audit requirements, then record.read for ifVersion. Only supplied Field public IDs change; stale versions are rejected. Returns bounded metadata; read values with targeted GQL.

recordId.description: Stable public live Record ID to update.

values.description: Public Field IDs mapped to explicitly supplied replacement values.

ifVersion.description: Record version returned by record.read; stale versions are rejected.

audit.description: Answers required by the Table audit policy, when configured.

answers.description: Audit question UUIDs mapped to their answers.

actions.title: Upsert external Grids Record
actions.description: Load gql.context kind fields with includeWriteContext true. Retry-safely bind provider + providerAccount + resourceKind + externalId to one Record. The first request creates it; later updates require ifVersion and patch only supplied Field IDs.

providerAccount.description: Stable provider account or tenant identity.

externalId.description: Stable id within the external system.

externalRef.description: Case-sensitive durable identity of the source record outside Grids.

values.description: Public Field IDs mapped to explicitly supplied values.

ifVersion.description: Required current Record version when the external identity already exists.

audit.description: Answers required by the Table audit policy for an existing Record update.

answers.description: Audit question UUIDs mapped to their answers.

actions.title: Save Grids query as View
actions.description: Save a reviewed GQL query as a new personal or shared View. Requires base admin access. Does not change tables or records. Never retry an uncertain result; inspect existing Views first.

query.description: Grids Query Language source to execute.

currentSource.description: Source for a query without an explicit from clause.

kind.description: Select a Table as the current source.
Select a View as the current source.

name.description: Name for the new saved View.

shared.description: Share the View with base readers; otherwise create a personal View. Both require base admin access.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

actions.title: Run a record workflow action
actions.description: Create one linked correction/cancellation Draft through an action from workflow.record-actions at its exact revision. The original must be finalized and remains unchanged. No issuance or external delivery. Obtain explicit approval; no arbitrary workflow source or extra inputs. Follow the run ref for status.

recordId.description: Record public ID from the returned table, obtained with GQL.

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by workflow.record-actions; changes require new approval.
